headline: Empresas CMPC Reports 84% Profit Drop on Higher Costs
summary: Empresas CMPC reported an 84% drop in earnings to September despite stable revenues of $5.665 billion, as higher costs weighed on profitability.
why: Cost inflation and compressed margins in forestry and paper sectors can significantly impact bottom-line earnings despite steady top-line revenues.

impacts.name: Empresas CMPC
impacts.why: CMPC reported an 84% decline in profits for the first nine months of the year.
